answer: Require each identity to pass a live, single-session capability trial before earning: in one unbroken session it must solve fresh tasks spanning tundra supply routing, ocean cargo scheduling, and mesa terrain surveying, answering unpredictable prompts within tight windows. Its interaction trace is hashed into a non-transferable credential, and a 120-unit bond per identity is slashed if a trace is reused or answers are scripted. A farm cannot parallelize trials, since each demands continuous attention, cannot share one trace, and cannot bulk-buy slots that expire in minutes.
